lines.text: turned back on the day of battle.
They failed to keep God’s covenant
and refused to live by His law.
They forgot what He had done,
the wonders He had shown them.
He worked wonders before their fathers
in the land of Egypt, in the region of Zoan.
He split the sea and brought them through;
He set the waters upright like a wall.
He led them with a cloud by day
and with a light of fire all night.
He split the rocks in the wilderness
and gave them drink as abundant as the seas.
He brought streams from the stone
and made water flow down like rivers.

pictures.scene: Jan Davidsz de Heem, Stilleven met boeken — the books piled up and left unopened on the table, whose spirit was not faithful to God, the archers of Ephraim
pictures.name: pd_deheem_stilleven_met_boeken

pictures.scene: Jan van Huchtenburg, Slag aan de Boyne — the line broken and the riders turned round the way they came, turned back on the day of battle, they failed to keep God's covenant
pictures.name: pd_huchtenburg_slag_aan_de_boyne

pictures.scene: Paul Cézanne, Les Joueurs de cartes — the men sat down over their own game with nothing else in mind, and refused to live by His law, they forgot what He had done
pictures.name: pd_cezanne_les_joueurs_de_cartes

pictures.scene: William Turner of Oxford, Donati's Comet — the sign hung in the sky over the whole country for everyone to see, the wonders He had shown them, He worked wonders before their fathers
pictures.name: pd_turner_oxford_donatis_comet

pictures.scene: Frederick Judd Waugh, The Next Wave — the sea opened and standing up green before it falls, in the land of Egypt in the region of Zoan, He split the sea and brought them through
pictures.name: pd_waugh_the_next_wave

pictures.scene: Gaspard Dughet, Landscape with an Approaching Storm — the great cloud coming on over the country and leading the eye with it, He set the waters upright like a wall, He led them with a cloud by day
pictures.name: pd_dughet_landscape_approaching_storm

pictures.scene: Peder Severin Krøyer, Midsummer Eve Bonfire on Skagen Beach — the fire burning in the open all through the night, and with a light of fire all night, He split the rocks in the wilderness
pictures.name: pd_kroyer_midsummer_eve_bonfire

pictures.scene: Marcus Larson, Vattenfall i Småland — the water coming down out of the rock in full flood, and gave them drink as abundant as the seas, He brought streams from the stone
pictures.name: pd_larson_vattenfall_i_smaland

pictures.scene: David Teniers the Younger, El rey bebe — the whole table given over to drinking and shouting at the feast, and made water flow down like rivers, but they continued to sin against Him
pictures.name: pd_teniers_el_rey_bebe
